name: Four Seasons Los Cabos at Costa Palmas
insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary sits on the pristine East Cape, where the Sea of Cortez meets untouched desert landscapes—a world away from Cabo's party scene yet close enough for adventure.
whats_special: The resort features the only Robert Trent Jones II golf course in Los Cabos with oceanfront holes, plus it's positioned on one of the few swimmable beaches in the region. The property spans 1,000 acres of protected coastline where sea turtles nest seasonally, and guests can spot migrating whales from December to April directly from their suites.
pro_tip: Book the signature spa treatment that uses indigenous Damiana herbs—this aphrodisiac plant grows wild in Baja California and has been used by locals for centuries.
dont_miss: The on-site tequila and mezcal tasting featuring small-batch spirits from family distilleries, and sunrise yoga on the beach where Jacques Cousteau once declared these waters "the world's aquarium" for their incredible marine biodiversity.
pros: Exceptional Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Prime beachfront location on the Sea of Cortez
Multiple dining venues with gourmet cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing point
Located outside central Cabo San Lucas area
